rows.label: Focus on AI citations and answers

items.q: How are AEO services different from SEO services?
items.a: SEO focuses heavily on discoverability and performance in search engines. AEO adds the question of how content, entities and evidence are interpreted and surfaced inside AI-generated answers. The disciplines overlap substantially, so Commview treats AEO as an extension of modern search strategy rather than an excuse to duplicate the same work.

items.q: How long until we get cited in AI answers?
items.a: There is no guaranteed timeline. AI systems choose and synthesise sources differently, their indexes and models change, and a technically correct page does not earn an automatic citation. We establish a baseline, improve the strongest controllable signals and track a repeatable query set so changes can be assessed over time.

items.q: Which AI engines do you optimise for?
items.a: We design for the underlying behaviours shared across AI-assisted discovery rather than promising a secret formula for one model. Depending on the audience, measurement can include systems such as ChatGPT, Google AI experiences, Perplexity and Claude. Coverage should follow where your buyers actually research and what can be measured responsibly.
